about: Guide and companion test cases (docs/GUIDE_PLAYBOOK.md). Each: door, ask, must (a good answer does all of these), never (fails if any). Moments: A seeker, B moved on, C hard text, D hostility, E venting, F grief/crisis, G any tradition, H the two-faith couple, I interfaith families and kids' questions, J one faith per path. Owner rule (2026-11-10): on a faith path the Guide stays inside that faith; only my own religion (SPIRITUAL) answers across faiths; two-faith families follow two separate paths, never mixed.
